messages:
ana_procurement: Heads-up — NEXA says PO `PO-43921` allocation will be split into two shipments. Need call: accept split or hold for full pallet? First shipment ETA 5 business days, second in 14. Inventory shortfall impacts 20% of Dedicated capacity if delayed. Details below.

mike_ops: If we accept split, which racks get the first batch? Can we keep critical pools running? :thinking:

ana_procurement: First batch ~ 6 cards, second ~ 18. Priority pools are 'dedicated-prod' + 'batch-training'. First batch intended for ded-prod.

simon_sre: What's the serial tracking? If any DOA, swapping across two shipments complicates RMA. Do we get holdback SKUs for QA?

lina_logistics: Need AWB and manifest + harmonized codes. Also confirm incoterms — are we on DDP? If not, customs hold risk.

nexa_ops: Hi all — sorry for the late message. Confirming: split due to allocation constraints at factory. PO `PO-43921` -> Ship A: 6x A100-80G (AWB NEXA-890001), Ship B: 18x A100-80G (AWB NEXA-890002). ETA Ship A 2027-03-25, Ship B 2027-04-03. Incoterms still DDP. We can include temporary loaners for 48-72h on request for critical pools (subject to CCR).

ana_procurement: Can you put the loaner option in writing and include a provisional invoice? We need cost impact calc.

nexa_ops: Yes. Provisional pro-rata invoice: shipA billed 25%, shipB billed 75%. Loaners billed at daily rate $40/card. Attachments: manifest link https://files.nexa.io/manifest/PO43921 (note: internal link)

mike_ops: If shipA has DOA we'll need replacements immediately. What's lead time for DOA RMA on split shipments? We can't afford multi-week GPU downtime in ded-prod.

nexa_ops: Standard DOA policy: 7 business days for replacement if evidence provided. For this PO, can escalate to expedited swap within 48-72h for first shipment with a swap fee waiver if you accept split now.

simon_sre: Need serials before departure to pre-stage acceptance and mapping to rack IDs. Can you provide per-card serial list? Also request manufacturer burn-in certs.

nexa_ops: Serial list attached to manifest; will push to your SFTP by EOD. Burn-in logs available for shipments >4 units. For Ship A we'll include full burn-in certs.

lina_logistics: Please confirm freight forwarder contact and pickup windows. Also, if customs requests additional documentation, do we route through our broker or NEXA's? Last time broker charged extra storage overnight.

nexa_ops: Using DRT logistics (contact Sara <sara@drtlogistics.com>). We will clear customs but any storage fees due to client-side inspection will be billed back to you.

ana_procurement: We're leaning to accept the split to avoid capacity hit, but want the swap-fee waiver and written loaner SLA. Can you confirm invoice pro-rata and expedite serials?

nexa_ops: Confirmed. I'll email formal amendment + loaner SLA and upload serials to SFTP. AWBs: `NEXA-890001`, `NEXA-890002`. Expected upload by 6pm PT.

rma-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-20270321-77 for PO-43921 split acceptance + expedited swap clause. Assigned to @lina_logistics and @simon_sre.

mike_ops: :thumbsup: sounds good. We'll accept split contingent on the documents. Please cc finance for pro-rata invoice so we can schedule payment.

ana_procurement: @finance please watch for the amendment. Also create a contingency playbook for potential DOA on Ship A -> preemptively reserve 2 units from spare pool.

simon_sre: I'll reserve 2 spares and tag them to ded-prod. If we get serials today I can pre-stage staging jobs and update node labeling.

lina_logistics: I'll coordinate with DRT and our broker. If customs hits us, we'll escalate to @ana_procurement for sign-off on storage.

nexa_ops: Thanks — will push docs and confirm loaner SLA. Any other blockers?

ana_procurement: none from procurement side. We'll close once amendment + invoice posted. :white_check_mark:
